# package rolemgmt

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/rolemgmt"
```

Package rolemgmt is the client of the role management of OPC 10000-18 (Role-Based Security): the RoleSet Object of a server (§4.3) with its Methods AddRole and RemoveRole (§4.2.2, §4.2.3), and the role Objects (RoleType, §4.4.1) with their Properties Identities, Applications, ApplicationsExclude, Endpoints, EndpointsExclude and CustomConfiguration and their Methods AddIdentity, RemoveIdentity, AddApplication, RemoveApplication, AddEndpoint and RemoveEndpoint (§4.4.5 to §4.4.10).

The Methods are called with the contracts of package uamethod: the arguments are packed and the results checked against the declarations of namespace 0. A Method of the Object is found by its BrowseName below the Object; an Object without it is called with the declaration of the type, which Part 4 §5.12.2.2 (1.05.06) allows. A Bad result is a \*uamethod.CallError, so errors.Is(err, ua.StatusBadUserAccessDenied) holds.

The server requires an encrypted channel and administrator rights such as the SecurityAdmin role for all of it, reading the Properties included (§4.4.1): connect with MessageSecurityModeSignAndEncrypt and a user the server grants SecurityAdmin.

## Types

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	Identities          []*ua.IdentityMappingRuleType
	Applications        []string
	ApplicationsExclude bool
	Endpoints           []*ua.EndpointType
	EndpointsExclude    bool
	CustomConfiguration bool
}
```

Config is the configuration of a role: the values of its Properties (§4.4.1). An optional Property the role does not have is zero.

### type Role

```go
func (r *Role) SetApplicationsExclude(ctx context.Context, exclude bool) error
```

SetEndpointsExclude writes EndpointsExclude: whether the Endpoints are an exclude list (§4.4.1).

#### func New

```go
func New(c *opcua.Client) *RoleSet
```

New returns the RoleSet of the server of c, the Object Server.ServerCapabilities.RoleSet of namespace 0.

#### func NewRoleSet

```go
func NewRoleSet(c *opcua.Client, obj *ua.NodeID) *RoleSet
```

NewRoleSet returns the RoleSetType Object obj of the server of c.

#### func (RoleSet) AddRole

```go
func (s *RoleSet) AddRole(ctx context.Context, name, namespaceURI string) (*Role, error)
```

AddRole adds the role name to the RoleSet (§4.2.2) and returns it. The name is qualified by namespaceURI; an empty one is the namespace the server chooses. A well-known role of OPC 10000-3 has the OPC UA namespace URI "[http://opcfoundation.org/UA/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/)".

#### func (RoleSet) NodeID

```go
func (s *RoleSet) NodeID() *ua.NodeID
```

NodeID returns the NodeId of the RoleSet.

#### func (RoleSet) RemoveRole

```go
func (s *RoleSet) RemoveRole(ctx context.Context, role *ua.NodeID) error
```

RemoveRole removes the role from the RoleSet (§4.2.3).

#### func (RoleSet) Role

```go
func (s *RoleSet) Role(nodeID *ua.NodeID) *Role
```

Role returns the role Object nodeID of the server.

#### func (RoleSet) Roles

```go
func (s *RoleSet) Roles(ctx context.Context) ([]*Role, error)
```

Roles returns the roles of the RoleSet: the Objects it has as components whose TypeDefinition is RoleType (§4.2.1). A role of a subtype of RoleType is recognized by the TypeDefinition of the type only, which this method does not follow.
